mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, command_key, command_type, request_digest, request_payload, object_code, record_id, business_key, flow_business_key, flow_model_key, process_instance_id, command_status, retry_count, next_retry_time, lock_owner, lock_time, error_type, remote_succeeded_time, completed_time, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_business_flow_remote_command SET command_status = #{status}, retry_count = LEAST(retry_count + 1, #{maxRetryCount}), next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, lock_owner = NULL, lock_time = NULL, error_type = #{errorType}, update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND command_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'REMOTE_SUCCEEDED')

UPDATE ai_business_flow_remote_command SET command_status = 'COMPLETED', next_retry_time = NULL, lock_owner = NULL, lock_time = NULL, error_type = NULL, completed_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND command_status IN ('REMOTE_SUCCEEDED', 'RETRY') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND process_instance_id != ''
